mapper.insert: insert into activity (name, channel, status, type, start_time, end_time, description, discount, voucher) values (#{name}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{type}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{description}, #{discount}, #{voucher})
mapper.update: update activity set name = #{name}, channel = #{channel}, status = #{status}, type = #{type}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, description = #{description}, discount = #{discount}, voucher = #{voucher} where id = #{id}
